column1: # Lalivero interiors: Sheba's family, the town's changing beliefs, wounded soldiers, Iodem and the ship.

column3:
Some still doubt that
{actor_name:7} has any power.{page_break}They should have seen
what {actor_name:7} can do before
speaking so carelessly.{end_wait}

Could Faran have been
wrong about her?{page_break}If {actor_name:7} has the power
he claims, how did they
manage to take her?{end_wait}
If {actor_name:7} cannot call on\nher gifts now, what use\nare they to her?{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} descended on the
ruins like a falling star.{page_break}The impact left a hollow
in the stone at the
center of the site.{end_wait}
Even {actor_name:7} could not\nhave fought six people\nalone...{end_wait}

A man named Iodem is
coming from Tolbi.{page_break}I wonder what he wants.
We have suffered enough
under that city.{end_wait}
No one has called for me.\nPerhaps I can rest for\na little while.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} said the cave
beneath the ruins leads
toward the southeast.{page_break}Could it really reach
all the way to Venus
Lighthouse?{end_wait}

The lighthouse foundation
is riddled with caves.{page_break}Find a way through them,
and perhaps the ruins
will finally make sense.{end_wait}

His wife keeps her
voice steady.{page_break}But I know she fears
for {actor_name:7} as much
as the rest of us.{end_wait}
Father will bring my\nsister {actor_name:7} home. I\nknow he will.{end_wait}
Oh, forgive me...{end_wait}
I keep thinking about\n{actor_name:7}. I cannot\nfocus on my work.{end_wait}
I know worrying will not\nhelp her. But I cannot\nstop thinking about it.{end_wait}
I should return to work.\nStanding here will not\nhelp her.{end_wait}
If I keep working, I\ncan keep my thoughts\nfrom turning dark.{end_wait}

The sea has become too
rough for fishing.{page_break}We have little to cook
when the boats cannot
leave the shore.{end_wait}
I searched the shore for\n{actor_name:7}, but the waves\nwere too violent.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} was taken hostage,\nand Faran followed them?{end_now}

We wanted to send boats
to search for {actor_name:7},{page_break}but the waves would
turn them over before
they reached the horizon.{end_wait}

You're a warrior, aren't
you? Bring {actor_name:7} home.{page_break}I'll lower the price
of anything you buy
from me.{end_wait}

The sea is too violent
for anyone to sail.{page_break}The Champa who rule
those waters are not
people to trust.{end_wait}

It must have been people
from Angara who took
{actor_name:7}.{page_break}Their soldiers have
brought nothing but
suffering here.{end_wait}
Babi Lighthouse has\nfallen, just as I feared\nit would.{end_wait}

Babi is not raising a
lighthouse{em_dash}he is raising
a monument to himself.{page_break}Perhaps he believes he
can stand among the gods.{end_wait}

I did not understand the
noise at first.{page_break}Then I saw the beacon
flare, and everyone
ran into the street.{end_wait}

Stay if you wish. Your
coin is welcome here.{page_break}But if you are a warrior,
why are you not searching
for {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
Wait outside Faran's\nhouse. I need to speak\nwith you privately.{end_wait}
Did you find {actor_name:7}?\nHow did the search end?{end_wait}
Do not lose hope for\n{actor_name:7}. I pray you can\nfind {actor_name:6} as well.{end_wait}
And what of {actor_name:6}?\nWhat became of the\nothers who went with you?{end_wait}

{actor_name:7}, if your power is
real, then use it now.{page_break}Please escape. I do not
know how much longer
we can wait.{end_wait}

A savior was meant to
come from the heavens...{page_break}I was foolish to think
that {actor_name:7} could be
that person.{end_wait}
I want to believe in\n{actor_name:7}.{page_break}Please, {actor_name:7}, escape.\nFind a way out of there.{end_wait}
She fell from the sky\nand suffered no wound.{page_break}They cannot hold\n{actor_name:7} forever.{end_wait}
If we lose {actor_name:7},\nwhat will Faran\nand his family do?{end_wait}

When Iodem arrives, he
will have to answer for
what Tolbi has done.{page_break}I wonder if this town
will ever be safe again.{end_wait}
I had forgotten how good\nit feels to rest.{end_wait}

How did {actor_name:7} know of
the caves beneath the
ruins?{page_break}Her visions cannot
all be true... can they?{end_wait}

Those caves are too
perilous for me.{page_break}If I were a warrior,
I would search them for
their hidden treasure.{end_wait}
Lalivero is not a town\nof fighters. Few will\nstand against Tolbi.{end_wait}

I want to go after
{actor_name:7}, but I've
never held a sword.{page_break}I can bring supplies.
That much I can do.{end_wait}
If {actor_name:7} is harmed...{page_break}I will never trade with\nanyone from Angara again.{end_wait}
Babi's tower will fall.\nA thing built on pride\ncannot stand forever.{end_wait}
A pot of mushroom soup.{page_break}The cook has added local\nbeans and herbs. It has\na rich, earthy smell.{end_wait}
A Lalivero salad with\npotato and cactus.{page_break}The cactus looks sharp.\nI wonder how it tastes.{end_wait}

A pot of thick stew,
made with whatever the
market could provide.{page_break}It should keep a person
strong through a long day.{end_wait}

The land split around
the lighthouse. The coast
beyond it now lies far{page_break}from Gondowan. I wonder
whether those lands will
ever draw close again.{end_wait}
What became of the people\nwho lived beyond the\nlighthouse?{end_wait}
I cannot bear to think\nwhat would happen if\nLalivero were swept away.{end_wait}

We were fortunate to be
on the northern side of
the lighthouse.{page_break}Had we lived beyond it,
we might not be here.{end_wait}
They say {actor_name:7} is safe.\nCan we trust that?{end_wait}

I used to tell
{actor_name:7} what this
town needed of her.{page_break}I never asked
what she needed
from us.{end_wait}
If she truly carries the\ngods' blessing, she will\nsurvive this.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} survived
one terrible fall.
I remember that.{page_break}But the sea is vast.
I don't know
what to hope.{end_wait}

They say Venus's
light will bring
{actor_name:7} back.{page_break}I want to believe it.
But none of us knows
what the sea has done.{end_wait}
We saw {actor_name:7}\nfall toward the sea.\nIt happened so fast.{end_wait}
I long for {actor_name:7} to\nreturn.{page_break}Everyone in Lalivero\nis waiting for her.{end_wait}
Babi Lighthouse fell when\nthe earth shook.{page_break}The ruins are unstable.\nNo one should enter them.{end_wait}
I wanted time away\nfrom work, but this\nendless quiet is worse.{end_wait}
The ruins do connect to\nVenus Lighthouse.{page_break}{actor_name:7} was right about\nthe path beneath them.{end_wait}
You solved the riddle\nof the ruins at last...{page_break}I never knew they led\nto Venus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Will the workers return,\nor is the lighthouse\nfinished for good?{end_wait}
I fear we will not be\npaid now that the work\nhas stopped.{end_wait}

We could never dig a
passage all the way to
Venus Lighthouse.{page_break}Whoever made that tunnel
must have known the land
better than we do.{end_wait}
Some secrets should have\nbeen left beneath the\nstone.{end_wait}
No one could swim through\nseas this violent.{end_wait}
When will the sea\nfinally grow calm?{end_wait}
The Champa come from a\ncoastal settlement in\nAngara.{end_wait}
First the lighthouse fell.\nPerhaps Babi will be next.{end_wait}

We received {actor_name:7} from
the heavens and raised
her as our own.{page_break}Faran will find her.
I know he will.{end_wait}

It hurts to imagine
anything happening to
{actor_name:7}.{page_break}I would take her place
without hesitation.{end_wait}
I only want someone\nto bring my sister\n{actor_name:7} home.{end_wait}

We obeyed Tolbi, and
that is how {actor_name:7} was
lost to us.{page_break}Babi is the one who
must answer for this.{end_wait}
Why did this happen\nto {actor_name:7}? I wish I\ncould wake from it.{end_wait}

The rooms are clean.
The sheets are changed.
Everything is in order.{page_break}And yet I cannot focus.
My thoughts keep drifting
to the girl.{end_wait}
When this is over, I\nhope Tolbi's soldiers\nleave Lalivero for good.{end_wait}
Freshwater fish from\nthe river, fried crisp.{page_break}Even the bones have\nsoftened in the pan.{end_wait}
Rice from the fields\nnear Lalivero.{page_break}The grains are soft and\nwill suit almost any meal.{end_wait}
Roast chicken in the oven.{page_break}The scent of garlic\nfills the whole room.{end_wait}
I must explain the promise\nto Lord Babi before\nit is too late.{end_wait}
So you are leaving us...{page_break}You will always be\nwelcome in Lalivero.{end_wait}
They say the lighthouse\nhas fallen. Perhaps it\nwas bound to happen.{end_wait}
You will find {actor_name:6}\nsomeday. Until then,\ntravel safely.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, the ship is\nyours now.{page_break}Take it wherever your\njourney leads.{end_wait}
I want no riches or\npraise{pause_20_skippable}. I only want\n{actor_name:7} safe.{page_break}{actor_name:7}...{end_wait}
Why does no one stop\n{actor_name:1} and his friends\nfrom leaving us?{end_wait}
Tolbi is responsible for\nwhat happened to {actor_name:7}.{page_break}I hope they remember\nwhat they have done.{end_wait}

There are people in
Angara like {actor_name:1} and
his companions...{page_break}If I were younger, I
might travel there too.{end_wait}
Use that ship to search\nfor Lemuria, the land\nBabi sought.{end_wait}
The beacon's light is\nbeautiful at night.{end_wait}
Why did the beacon make\nsuch a thunderous sound?{page_break}Was that the star-like\nlight above the tower?{end_wait}
These bright nights keep\nme awake. I can hardly\nkeep my eyes open.{end_wait}
What should I make\nfor dinner tonight?{end_wait}
